title: Cowboy Language Pack
description: A resource pack to add a cowboy language to Minecraft.
body:
Fully implements a version of Minecraft's default  English language with one full of cowboy speakin' and lingo. This is a separate language than the English one, so you can turn it on or off whenever you like.
**NOTE:** When selecting the resource pack, ensure it is placed **UNDER** the default Minecraft pack. (see Gallery)
